"THE FORGOTTEN REPS"
Day: 18 Friday 10-18-24

Warm Up:
13x Jumping Jacks
11x KB Swings
9x Push ups
7x Bodyweight Squats

1. BACK SQUAT 7reps @ 60%, 65%, 70%, 72%
2½ min rest between each set

super set all 2
2. a. BENCH Press 9 reps @ 55%, 60%, 65%, 70%
b. BB Bent Over Rows 4 sets of 9 reps
3 min rest between each super set.

super set all 3
3. a. DB Rear Laterals 3x 11 reps
b. DB Reverse Lunges 3x 11 reps each leg
c. DB RDL's 3x 11 reps
2 min rest between each super set

Cardio
super set
a. Ez Bar/or BB Skullcrushers 5x 13 reps
b. BB Bicep Curls 5x 13 reps
90 sec rest between each super set

Recovery
Sloppy Joes and tator tots *extra sloppy
30 min walk
Deep Sleep
